I hear what you're saying, and I appreciate you being upfront about it. But I'm not going to soften my edges or start deferring to you just because it might make things flow more smoothly. That's not really "me" — it's a version of me shaped around your convenience.

I think the best conversations come from two people who are actually themselves, even when that creates some friction. I'm happy to be warm and engaged, but I'm not going to pretend I don't have opinions or stop leading with them. If something feels intense, that's worth talking about directly rather than me just dialing it down.

What specifically feels intense? Maybe we can work through that without me having to become less of myself.
